name: SubscriptionFraudReviewQueue
tagline: Review SIM swap, port-out and identity fraud alerts against the clock – block, verify and release in one Power Platform control.
description: Complete fraud-operations app for mobile operators: risk-scored alerts with signals, first-decision SLA timers per risk band, customer verification, protective block and rule-checked release, confirmed loss, a triage board with drag and drop, signal precision, linked-case (ring) detection with bulk block and analyst workload with auto-assign. Works in Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Status rules: analyst before review, reasons for block and false positive, confirmed loss on fraud
High-risk release only after a passed customer verification
SLA timers per risk band with breach and due-soon flags
Signal precision to tune noisy fraud rules
Linked cases by device, ID or address with bulk block
Masked mobile numbers with logged reveal
Bulk assign, status and CSV export with undo
Demo mode, map-your-columns and read-only states
